|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Gold 1 (V) (Virtual Set 1)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #1a sheet (PDF made 5 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “May add 2 pilots or passengers. Once per control phase, may use 1 Force (free if Dutch aboard) to take the top or bottom card of your Force Pile into hand. Power + 2 and immune to attrition < 4 while Dutch piloting.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Gold 1 (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata)]]): the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “May add 2 pilots or passengers. Once per control phase, may use 1 Force (free if Dutch aboard) to take the top or bottom card of your Force Pile into hand. Power + 2 and immune to attrition < 4 while Dutch piloting.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same as the previous version; the slip's look differs (Decipher's sheet prints Dark Side text boxes black on white and prints collector numbers V1•1–V1•12; the 5 March sheet prints Dark Side boxes white on black and no numbers). Listed as its own version because it is a separate publication (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 1: Legacy, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “May add 2 pilots or passengers. If Dutch piloting, power +2, immune to attrition < 4, and once during any control phase, may take the top or bottom card of your Force Pile into hand.” '''What changed:''' “Once per” → “If Dutch piloting, power +2, immune to attrition < 4, and once during any”; removed “use 1 Force (free if Dutch aboard) to”; removed “Power + 2 and immune to attrition < 4 while Dutch piloting.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153847/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards1.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards1.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 03. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Gold 1]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy#Cards|Virtual Set 1: Legacy]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Gold 1 (V) (Virtual Set 1)]], [[Gold 1 (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Gold 1]]. Code OVS1 · GEMP id 1101_3.
